decision.summary: A clear multi-sample downward step in E and U begins around index 435 and persists through 449. While a large opposing jump is reported at index 450, the subsequent observations (450–485) do not confirm full recovery to the pre-offset baseline on either axis; residual offsets remain. Thus, the interval is classified as uncertain due to unconfirmed return within allowed context. N shows no coherent offset, only minor correlated fluctuations.

intervals.observation: Sustained downward offset in E (≈−12 MAD) and U (≈−10 MAD) beginning near index 435, persisting through index 449; N shows only minor correlated noise. A candidate opposing jump at index 450 (E +14.7, U +11.1 MAD) suggests a return, but the return is not fully observed within the allowed context (ends at 485), and the post-450 segment does not yet rejoin the pre-offset baseline level—U remains ~−4 to −6 MAD, E ~−3 to −5 MAD through 485. Hence, return is incomplete/ambiguous.
